title: Remove obsolete project coupling
body:
## Summary
- Replace obsolete project-specific policy, profile, schema, and prompt wording with generic project-profile rules.
- Use the generic nextjs_web profile and project-agnostic visual_evidence contract.
- Clean stale root artifacts and remove obsolete project memory from the control plane.

## Validation
- make validate-artifacts
- make security
- focused pytest
- full pytest
- make check
